about: The user's ratings of round 1's fifty runs (runs.py as committed in 6e81ace), from 1 (I don't like it) to 10 (I really like it), with their comments, from the rating page's database (collection ratings); and, for runs 1-15, the Want/Maybe/Avoid mark and note they gave in the gallery before it (collection runs). Read 16 November 2026.
